answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the knoll of the next round. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
